title: ReviewEvent
description: An auditable transition in the review status of a subject (a DerivedEntity, DerivedRelation, or RelationEvidence). Review events form the audit trail of the curation lifecycle and are distinct from provenance activities and from evidential state.

id.description: Opaque, unique identifier for this review event.

subjectType.description: The type of object whose review status changed.

fromStatus.description: The review status before the transition.

toStatus.description: The review status after the transition.

reviewer.description: The agent who performed the review.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the transition.

supersededById.description: When toStatus is `superseded`, the identifier of the object that supersedes the subject.
